224:t_3:27.en:
$$セツコ$$
「And beyond here... lies the information on the end of the universe...」

224:t_3:33.en:
$$アルト$$
「Are you... $$プロトカルチャー$$...?」

224:t_3:34.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「I store the words the $$プロトカルチャー$$ left behind, and it is my duty to hand them down to the ages to come. I am the one who sleeps here.」

224:t_3:35.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「When one who is a token of peace touches it, the door shall open, and I shall awake from my sleep.」

224:t_3:36.en:
$$アルト$$
「Are you talking about $$ランカ$$...?」

224:t_3:37.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Tell me, will of the $$プロトカルチャー$$. What exactly is the end of the universe that comes once every 12,000 years?」

224:t_3:38.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「I shall answer. It is also something I am meant to pass on.」

224:t_3:39.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「The end of the universe... It lies in erasing the power of life from the universe.」

224:t_3:41.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Could that be about $$バサラ$$...!?」

224:t_3:42.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「By the power of life, do you mean the 《$$アニマスピリチア$$》 that sealed the $$プロトデビルン$$?」

224:t_3:43.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「Of course, that is included. But the power of life is something more universal... Every living thing possesses it.」

224:t_3:44.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「It is what governs the principle of all things... In other words, it is also the key that draws out the $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

224:t_3:46.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You mean $$次元力$$... don't you...」

224:t_3:47.en:
$n
「It's true that the $$スフィア$$s also draw out $$次元力$$ through human emotions and hearts, but...」

224:t_3:48.en:
$$スズネ$$
(I see... I'm starting to get the picture.)

224:t_3:50.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「Once every 12,000 years, the universe tries to be reborn.」

224:t_3:51.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「The force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist... The two energies collide...」

224:t_3:52.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「To erase the force that seeks to exist, the force that seeks to vanish tries to erase the power of life.」

224:t_3:53.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「That is what gives birth to $$バアル$$.」

224:t_3:54.en:
$n
「The universe itself gives birth to $$バアル$$...」

224:t_3:55.en:
$$アルト$$
「So the end of the universe and $$バアル$$ really were connected...!」

224:t_3:56.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「Yet life does not perish... Through beasts' blood, mingling waters, the wind's course, fire's civilization, and then the sun's radiance, it walks the path of $$シンカ$$...」

224:t_3:58.en:
$$アルト$$
「Tell me. What does it mean?」

224:t_3:59.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「$$シンカ$$ is not something anyone can teach. It is something you reach by your own power.」

224:t_3:60.en:
$n
「You're saying the same thing as $$ゼウス神#pilot$$...!」

224:t_3:61.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「Those who open the door of $$シンカ$$ will stand against the end of the universe... And that will become the power to overcome the true end that is yet to come...」

224:t_3:63.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「12,000 years... Repeat that ten thousand times, and the universe meets its true end... the great collapse.」

224:t_3:64.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「That will be the final battle... The force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist will clash with everything they have...」

224:t_3:65.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「It will draw in every parallel world that exists.」

224:t_3:67.en:
$$セツコ$$
「12,000 years, ten thousand times... That makes 120 million years...」

224:t_3:68.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「The power that overcomes it... is the pinnacle of $$シンカ$$... In other words, the power of a god...」

224:t_3:69.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「Gods and devils... The battle between the higher life forms and $$バアル$$... That is the way to overcome the end...」

224:t_3:70.en:
$$アルト$$
「A battle of gods and devils...」

224:t_3:71.en:
$n
「So that's what the $$ミケーネ神$$s were talking about...」

224:t_3:72.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「But there is one who has forgotten the mission of the higher life forms. That one... claims to be a messenger of God...」

224:t_3:73.en:
$$プロトカルチャー$$
「Ohh! My will... my memory...!」

224:t_3:74.en:
$n
「Wait! We still have things we want to ask you!」

224:t_3:75.en:
$$セツコ$$
「No, $n! The ruins are already collapsing!」

224:t_3:76.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ランカ$$! We're getting out of here!」

224:t_3:79.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let $$ランカ$$ ride in my own aircraft」
「Let $$ランカ$$ ride in $$ブレラ$$'s aircraft」

224:t_3:80.en:
$$アルト$$
「Get in my VF-25! Let's hurry!」

224:t_3:81.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Okay...! I'm counting on you, $$アルト$$!」

224:t_3:82.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ブレラ$$! Take care of $$ランカ$$!」

224:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, $$アルト$$. You were a star out there today.」

224:t_10:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「I had $$ランカ$$ riding behind me. I couldn't afford to get hit.」

224:t_10:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Sorry, but we sortie again right away. If it's a talk you want, it'll have to wait.」

224:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Are you aware of it, $$アルト$$? That when you put $$ランカ$$ in your own aircraft, your heart wavered...」

224:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What kind of emotion that was, I, a robot, cannot tell, but it produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z.」

224:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add them to the unit's stock. And from now on as well, I shall keep following where the hearts of $$アルト$$, $$ランカ$$... and $$シェリル$$ lead.」

224:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The day the three of you settle your relationship... Whatever answer it turns out to be, I'm sure a great many $$Ｚチップ$$s will be produced...」

224:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, $$ブレラ$$. You were a star out there today.」

224:t_10:14.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I had $$ランカ$$ aboard... No mistakes were allowed.」

224:t_10:15.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「If you have no business with me, I'm leaving. Another sortie is coming right away.」

224:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Is that gruffness a way of hiding embarrassment...? Still, within him there is certainly love for $$ランカ$$.」

224:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

224:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「However, $$ランカ$$ is also a woman in her own right. There are worlds that even siblings cannot step into.」

224:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The day the three of you settle your relationship... Whatever answer it turns out to be, I'm sure a great many $$Ｚチップ$$s will be produced...」

224:t_10:25.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$ランカ$$... You can sing again, huh.」

224:t_10:26.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Yeah... Sorry for worrying you all this time, Big Bro.」

224:t_10:29.en:
$$オズマ$$
「You've been reunited with $$ブレラ$$, too. You don't have to force yourself to call me Big Bro anymore.」

224:t_10:30.en:
$$オズマ$$
「If you like, you could even change your name to $$ランカ・スターン$$...」

224:t_10:33.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Why do you say such sad things...? To me, you're both my Big Bro...」
